Hi!
My name’s Palmer.I heard a lot about you.
You are {STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0} from New Bark Town, right?You are much younger than I thought.
So, I’d like you to show me.Show me the bond you’ve built with
your Pokémon.Show me what you’ve learned
through battles with Trainers!

give you my best effort.That’s how the best Trainers show
respect to each other.By battling all out as dedicated
students of Pokémon!
